items.en_self: I would be quite bored by a visit to an art gallery.
items.en_observer: He/she would be quite bored by a visit to an art gallery.
items.ja_self: 美術館に行くと，とても退屈してしまう。

items.en_self: I clean my office or home quite frequently.
items.en_observer: He/she cleans his/her office or home quite frequently.
items.ja_self: 私は，自分の家の部屋やオフィス（仕事場）を頻繁に掃除する。

items.en_self: I rarely hold a grudge, even against people who have badly wronged me.
items.en_observer: He/she rarely holds a grudge, even against people who have badly wronged him/her.
items.ja_self: たとえひどく不当な扱いをされた相手に対しても，めったに悪意を抱くことはない。

items.en_self: I feel reasonably satisfied with myself overall.
items.en_observer: He/she feels reasonably satisfied with himself/herself overall.
items.ja_self: 私は全体的に自分自身にほどよく満足していると感じている。

items.en_self: I would feel afraid if I had to travel in bad weather conditions.
items.en_observer: He/she would feel afraid if he/she had to travel in bad weather conditions.
items.ja_self: 悪天候のときに旅行をしなければならないとしたら，怖れを感じる。

items.en_self: If I want something from a person I dislike, I will act very nicely toward that person in order to get it.
items.en_observer: If he/she wants something from a person he/she dislikes, he/she will act very nicely toward that person in order to get it.
items.ja_self: もし自分が嫌いな人に何かをしてほしいときには，そのために，その人に対して愛想よく行動するだろう。

items.en_self: I'm interested in learning about the history and politics of other countries.
items.en_observer: He/she is interested in learning about the history and politics of other countries.
items.ja_self: 他の国の歴史や政治について学ぶことに興味がある。

items.en_self: When working, I often set ambitious goals for myself.
items.en_observer: When working, he/she often sets ambitious goals for himself/herself.
items.ja_self: 仕事をするときには，しばしば自分からみて野心的な(高い)目標を設定する。

items.en_self: People sometimes tell me that I am too critical of others.
items.en_observer: People sometimes say that he/she is too critical of others.
items.ja_self: 人からときどき，他人に対して批判的すぎると言われる。

items.en_self: I rarely express my opinions in group meetings.
items.en_observer: He/she rarely expresses his/her opinions in group meetings.
items.ja_self: 集団での話し合いでは，自分の意見を言うことはめったにない。

items.en_self: I sometimes can't help worrying about little things.
items.en_observer: He/she worries about little things.
items.ja_self: ちょっとしたことが心配になって，それを抑えることができないことがある。

items.en_self: If I knew that I could never get caught, I would be willing to steal a million dollars.
items.en_observer: If he/she knew that he/she could never get caught, he/she would be willing to steal a million dollars.
items.ja_self: もし決して捕まらないとわかっているのなら，私は1億円を盗もうと思う。

items.en_self: I would like a job that requires following a routine rather than being creative.
items.en_observer: He/she would like a job that requires following a routine rather than being creative.
items.ja_self: 創造性を求められるよりも，決まったとおりにやることを求められる仕事をしたい。

items.en_self: I often check my work over repeatedly to find any mistakes.
items.en_observer: He/she often checks his/her work over repeatedly to find any mistakes.
items.ja_self: 一つも間違いがないように，しばしば何度も自分の仕事をチェックする。

items.en_self: People sometimes tell me that I'm too stubborn.
items.en_observer: People sometimes think that he/she is too stubborn.
items.ja_self: ときどき人から，私は頑固すぎると言われる。

items.en_self: I avoid making "small talk" with people.
items.en_observer: He/she avoids making "small talk" with people.
items.ja_self: 人と雜談をすることを避けている。

items.en_self: When I suffer from a painful experience, I need someone to make me feel comfortable.
items.en_observer: When he/she suffers from a painful experience, he/she needs someone to make him/her feel comfortable.
items.ja_self: 苦痛な体験に苦しんでいるときには，慰めを与えてくれる人が必要である。

items.en_self: Having a lot of money is not especially important to me.
items.en_observer: Having a lot of money is not especially important to him/her.
items.ja_self: 大金を持つことは，自分にとって特に重要なことではない。

items.en_self: I think that paying attention to radical ideas is a waste of time.
items.en_observer: He/she thinks that paying attention to radical ideas is a waste of time.
items.ja_self: とても斬新で慣習にとらわれない考えを考慮することは，時間の無駄だと思う。

items.en_self: I make decisions based on the feeling of the moment rather than on careful thought.
items.en_observer: He/she makes decisions based on the feeling of the moment rather than on careful thought.
items.ja_self: 私は，よく考えた上でよりも，そのときの気持ち次第で物事を決める（ことがある）。

items.en_self: People think of me as someone who has a quick temper.
items.en_observer: People think of him/her as someone who has a quick temper.
items.ja_self: 他の人は，私のことを短気な人間だと思っている。

items.en_self: I am energetic nearly all the time.
items.en_observer: He/she is energetic nearly all the time.
items.ja_self: ほとんどいつでもエネルギッシュ（活動的）である。

items.en_self: I feel like crying when I see other people crying.
items.en_observer: He/she feels like crying when he/she sees other people crying.
items.ja_self: 他の人が泣いているのをみると，私も泣きたくなる。

items.en_self: I am an ordinary person who is no better than others.
items.en_observer: He/she thinks that he/she is an ordinary person who is no better than others.
items.ja_self: 私は，他の人より特に優れているわけではない普通の人間である。

items.en_self: I wouldn't spend my time reading a book of poetry.
items.en_observer: He/she wouldn't spend his/her time reading a book of poetry.
items.ja_self: 詩集を読むことに時間を使うことはない。

items.en_self: I plan ahead and organize things, to avoid scrambling at the last minute.
items.en_observer: He/she plans ahead and organizes things, to avoid scrambling at the last minute.
items.ja_self: 最後になってあわてないために，前もって計画を立ててものごとの準備をする。

items.en_self: My attitude toward people who have treated me badly is "forgive and forget".
items.en_observer: His/her attitude toward people who have treated him/her badly is "forgive and forget".
items.ja_self: 私にひどいことをした人に対する私の態度は，「許して忘れる」ことである。

items.en_self: I think that most people like some aspects of my personality.
items.en_observer: He/she thinks that most people like some aspects of his/her personality.
items.ja_self: ほとんどの人が私の性格のうちのいくつかの要素を好きだと私は思っている。

items.en_self: I don’t mind doing jobs that involve dangerous work.
items.en_observer: He/she doesn't mind doing jobs that involve dangerous work.
items.ja_self: 危険な作業がある仕事をすることは心配にならない。

items.en_self: I wouldn't use flattery to get a raise or promotion at work, even if I thought it would succeed.
items.en_observer: He/she wouldn't use flattery to get a raise or promotion at work, even if he/she thought it would succeed.
items.ja_self: たとえそうすればうまくいくと思っても，仕事の上で昇進するためにお世辞を言ったりしようとは思わない。

items.en_self: I enjoy looking at maps of different places.
items.en_observer: He/she enjoys looking at maps of different places.
items.ja_self: いろいろな場所の地図を見ることは楽しい。

items.en_self: I often push myself very hard when trying to achieve a goal.
items.en_observer: He/she often pushes himself/herself very hard when trying to achieve a goal.
items.ja_self: 目標を達成しようとするときは，しばしば自分をとても激しく追い詰める。

items.en_self: I generally accept people’s faults without complaining about them.
items.en_observer: He/she generally accepts people’s faults without complaining about them.
items.ja_self: たいていは，文句を言わずに人の失敗を受け入れる。

items.en_self: In social situations, I'm usually the one who makes the first move.
items.en_observer: In social situations, he/she is usually the one who makes the first move.
items.ja_self: 社会的（対人）場面では，たいてい私がはじめに行動する人間である。

items.en_self: I worry a lot less than most people do.
items.en_observer: He/she worries a lot less than most people do.
items.ja_self: 他の人ほどは心配性ではない。

items.en_self: I would be tempted to buy stolen property if I were financially tight.
items.en_observer: He/she would be tempted to buy stolen property if he/she were financially tight.
items.ja_self: お金に余裕がない場合は，盗品とはわかっていても購入したいという誘惑を感じることがある。

items.en_self: I would enjoy creating a work of art, such as a novel, a song, or a painting.
items.en_observer: He/she would enjoy creating a work of art, such as a novel, a song, or a painting.
items.ja_self: 小説を書いたり，曲を作ったり，絵を描いたりといった，芸術作品を創作することは楽しい。

items.en_self: When working on something, I don't pay much attention to small details.
items.en_observer: When working on something, he/she doesn't pay much attention to small details.
items.ja_self: 何かの仕事をするとき，細かい点にはあまり注意を払わない。

items.en_self: I am usually quite flexible in my opinions when people disagree with me.
items.en_observer: He/she is usually quite flexible in his/her opinions when people disagree with him/her.
items.ja_self: 人が私に同調しないときは，私はたいてい自分の意見について，かなり柔軟である。

items.en_self: I enjoy having lots of people around to talk with.
items.en_observer: He/she enjoys having lots of people around to talk with.
items.ja_self: 周囲に多くの話し相手がいる時は楽しい。

items.en_self: I can handle difficult situations without needing emotional support from anyone else.
items.en_observer: He/she can handle difficult situations without needing emotional support from anyone else.
items.ja_self: 誰かの感情的な支えがないとしても，困難な状況に対処することができる。

items.en_self: I would like to live in a very expensive, high-class neighborhood.
items.en_observer: He/she would like to live in a very expensive, high-class neighborhood.
items.ja_self: 非常に地価が高く，近隣に社会的地位の高い人が住んでいる場所に住みたい。

items.en_self: I like people who have unconventional views.
items.en_observer: He/she likes people who have unconventional views.
items.ja_self: 私は，型にはまらない見方をする人が好きである。

items.en_self: I make a lot of mistakes because I don't think before I act.
items.en_observer: He/she makes a lot of mistakes because he/she doesn't think before he/she acts.
items.ja_self: 行動する前に考えないので，たくさんの失敗をしてしまう。

items.en_self: I rarely feel anger, even when people treat me quite badly.
items.en_observer: He/she rarely feels anger, even when people treat him/her quite badly.
items.ja_self: たとえ人から明らかにひどい扱いを受けたときでも，めったに怒りは感じない。

items.en_self: On most days, I feel cheerful and optimistic.
items.en_observer: On most days, he/she feels cheerful and optimistic.
items.ja_self: たいていは，元気で楽天的である。

items.en_self: When someone I know well is unhappy, I can almost feel that person's pain myself.
items.en_observer: When someone he/she knows well is unhappy, he/she can almost feel that person's pain himself/herself.
items.ja_self: 自分がよく知っている人が悲しんでいるときには，その人の苦痛をほとんど自分のことのように感じることがある。

items.en_self: I wouldn’t want people to treat me as though I were superior to them.
items.en_observer: He/she wouldn’t want people to treat him/her as though he/she were superior to them.
items.ja_self: 自分が他の人よりも優れているかのように周囲の人から扱われることを望まない。

items.en_self: If I had the opportunity, I would like to attend a classical music concert.
items.en_observer: If he/she had the opportunity, he/she would like to attend a classical music concert.
items.ja_self: もし機会があれば，クラシック音楽の演奏会に行きたい。

items.en_self: People often joke with me about the messiness of my room or desk.
items.en_observer: People often joke with him/her about the messiness of his/her room or desk.
items.ja_self: 私の部屋や机の上の散らかり具合のことで，人によくからかわれる。

items.en_self: If someone has cheated me once, I will always feel suspicious of that person.
items.en_observer: If someone has cheated him/her once, he/she will always feel suspicious of that person.
items.ja_self: もし一度でも誰かにだまされたら，いつでもその人に疑いを持つだろう。

items.en_self: I feel that I am an unpopular person.
items.en_observer: He/she feels that he/she is an unpopular person.
items.ja_self: 自分は人気がない人間だと感じている。

items.en_self: When it comes to physical danger, I am very fearful.
items.en_observer: When it comes to physical danger, he/she is very fearful.
items.ja_self: 身体的な危険が迫ると，とても怖い。

items.en_self: If I want something from someone, I will laugh at that person's worst jokes.
items.en_observer: If he/she wants something from someone, he/she will laugh at that person's worst jokes.
items.ja_self: もし，何かをある人から手に入れようと思っているときには，その人がくだらない冗談を言っても笑うだろう。

items.en_self: I would be very bored by a book about the history of science and technology.
items.en_observer: He/she would be very bored by a book about the history of science and technology.
items.ja_self: 科学技術の歴史についての本は，私にとってはとても退屈である。

items.en_self: Often when I set a goal, I end up quitting without having reached it.
items.en_observer: Often when he/she sets a goal, he/she ends up quitting without having reached it.
items.ja_self: 目標を設定しても，しばしば，それを達成せずにやめてしまう。

items.en_self: I tend to be lenient in judging other people.
items.en_observer: He/she tends to be lenient in judging other people.
items.ja_self: 他の人を判断するときには，甘い(手加減する)傾向がある。

items.en_self: When I'm in a group of people, I'm often the one who speaks on behalf of the group.
items.en_observer: When he/she is in a group of people, he/she is often the one who speaks on behalf of the group.
items.ja_self: 集団の中にいるとき，しばしばその集団を代表して話をする人間である。

items.en_self: I rarely, if ever, have trouble sleeping due to stress or anxiety.
items.en_observer: He/she rarely, if ever, has trouble sleeping due to stress or anxiety.
items.ja_self: ストレスや不安で眠れなくなったことは，めったにない。

items.en_self: I would never accept a bribe, even if it were very large.
items.en_observer: He/she would never accept a bribe, even if it were very large.
items.ja_self: たとえどんなに大金でも，賄賂は決して受け取らない。

items.en_self: People have often told me that I have a good imagination.
items.en_observer: He/she has a good imagination.
items.ja_self: ࠀࠂࠊࠌࠜࡺࡼࡾࢎ࢖ࢠࣆࣈ࣐࣒࣊࣌ࣘࣾ쿖믈Ʞ醞瞊恮㝏ᔯ佨衤ᘀ졨詳䌀ᅊ伀͊倀͊儀͊帀Ɋ愀ᅊ洀ै漐Ĩ䡳ဉᔠ佨衤ᘀ졨詳䌀၊倀J愀၊洀ै猐ैᔛ豨䈽ᘀㅨ謐倀͊渀ᅈ漄Ĩ䡴Бᔐ졨鉒ᘀㅨ謐䌀⡊̤jᔀ졨鉒ᘀㅨ謐䌀ᑊ唀Ĉ䡭Ѐ䡮Ѐࡵᔌ졨鉒ᘀㅨ謐ᔘ塨唣ᘀ୨䌀⁊洀ፈ猄ፈᔐ㝨⡞ᘀ୨䌀⁊ᔐ╨灷ᘀ୨䌀⁊ᘕ୨䌀⁊洀ፈ漄Ĩ䡳Гᔘ╨灷ᘀ୨䌀⁊洀ፈ猄ፈᘍ୨䌀⁊漀Ĩᘍㅨ謐䌀⁊漀Ĩᔐ졨鉒ᘀㅨ謐䌀⁊̚jᘀŨ唀Ĉ䡭Ѐ䡮Ѐࡵᘆㅨ謐ᔛ㡨㬍ᘀㅨ謐倀͊渀ᅈ漄Ĩ䡴Бሀࠀࠂࠄࠆࠈࠊࠎࠐࠒࠔࠖ࠘ࠚࠜࡼࡾࣈ࣐࣒࣊࣎ࣖࣘऀù÷÷÷÷÷÷ò÷òÞ�ÕᘀĤ晉摧珈

items.en_self: I always try to be accurate in my work, even at the expense of time.
items.en_observer: He/she always tries to be accurate in his/her work, even at the expense of time.
items.ja_self: たとえ時間がかかっても，自分の仕事ではいつも正確であるようにしている。

items.en_self: When people tell me that I’m wrong, my first reaction is to argue with them.
items.en_observer: When people tell him/her that he/she is wrong, his/her first reaction is to argue with them.
items.ja_self: 人から私が間違っていると言われたとき，私の最初の反応は，相手に同意しないことである。

items.en_self: I prefer jobs that involve active social interaction to those that involve working alone.
items.en_observer: He/she prefers jobs that involve active social interaction to those that involve working alone.
items.ja_self: 一人でやるよりも，積極的な人との関わりを含む仕事の方が好きだ。

items.en_self: Whenever I feel worried about something, I want to share my concern with another person.
items.en_observer: Whenever he/she feels worried about something, he/she wants to share his/her concern with another person.
items.ja_self: 何か心配なことがあるときは，いつでも自分の問題を他の人と共有することを求める。

items.en_self: I would like to be seen driving around in a very expensive car.
items.en_observer: He/she would like to be seen driving around in a very expensive car.
items.ja_self: 高級車でドライブしているところを人に見られたい。

items.en_self: I think of myself as a somewhat eccentric person.
items.en_observer: I think of him/her as a somewhat eccentric person.
items.ja_self: 自分のことを，ちょっと変わった人間だと思っている。

items.en_self: I don’t allow my impulses to govern my behavior.
items.en_observer: He/she doesn’t allow his/her impulses to govern his/her behavior.
items.ja_self: 自分の衝動のままに行動するようなことはない。

items.en_self: Most people tend to get angry more quickly than I do.
items.en_observer: Most people tend to get angry more quickly than he/she does.
items.ja_self: たいていの人は，私よりもすぐに怒り出す。

items.en_self: People often tell me that I should try to cheer up.
items.en_observer: People often tell him/her that he/she should try to cheer up.
items.ja_self: よく人から，もっと元気を出すように言われることがある。

items.en_self: I feel strong emotions when someone close to me is going away for a long time.
items.en_observer: He/she feels strong emotions when someone close to him/her is going away for a long time.
items.ja_self: 自分と親しい人が長い間遠くに行ってしまうときには，強い感情を感じる。

items.en_self: I think that I am entitled to more respect than the average person is.
items.en_observer: He/she thinks that he/she is entitled to more respect than the average person is.
items.ja_self: 私は，平均的な人間よりも，尊重される権利があると思う。

items.en_self: Sometimes I like to just watch the wind as it blows through the trees.
items.en_observer: Sometimes he/she likes to just watch the wind as it blows through the trees.
items.ja_self: ときには，木々の間を吹き抜ける風を見るだけでも楽しい。

items.en_self: When working, I sometimes have difficulties due to being disorganized.
items.en_observer: When working, he/she sometimes has difficulties due to being disorganized.
items.ja_self: 仕事をしているとき，ときどき自分がだらしがないために困ってしまうことがある。

items.en_self: I find it hard to fully forgive someone who has done something mean to me.
items.en_observer: He/she finds it hard to fully forgive someone who has done something mean to him/her.
items.ja_self: 私にひどいことをした人のことを，完全に許すことはなかなかできない。

items.en_self: I sometimes feel that I am a worthless person.
items.en_observer: He/she sometimes feels that he/she is a worthless person.
items.ja_self: 時々自分は価値のない人間だと感じる。

items.en_self: Even in an emergency I wouldn't feel like panicking.
items.en_observer: Even in an emergency he/she wouldn't feel like panicking.
items.ja_self: たとえ非常(緊急)の場合でも，あわてふためいたりすることはない。

items.en_self: I wouldn't pretend to like someone just to get that person to do favors for me.
items.en_observer: He/she wouldn't pretend to like someone just to get that person to do favors for him/her.
items.ja_self: 誰かに私のたのみを聞いてもらうために，その人を好きなふりをしようとは思わない。

items.en_self: I’ve never really enjoyed looking through an encyclopedia.
items.en_observer: He/she has never really enjoyed looking through an encyclopedia.
items.ja_self: 百科事典を読むことを楽しんだことはない。

items.en_self: I do only the minimum amount of work needed to get by.
items.en_observer: He/she does only the minimum amount of work needed to get by.
items.ja_self: 必要とされる最低限の仕事しかしない。

items.en_self: Even when people make a lot of mistakes, I rarely say anything negative.
items.en_observer: Even when people make a lot of mistakes, he/she rarely says anything negative.
items.ja_self: たとえ人がたくさん間違いを犯したときでも，私はめったに否定的なことは言わない。

items.en_self: I tend to feel quite self-conscious when speaking in front of a group of people.
items.en_observer: He/she tends to feel quite self-conscious when speaking in front of a group of people.
items.ja_self: 人々の前で話をするときには，とても恥ずかしさを感じてしまう傾向がある。

items.en_self: I get very anxious when waiting to hear about an important decision.
items.en_observer: He/she gets very anxious when waiting to hear about an important decision.
items.ja_self: 重要な決定の結果を聞くのを待っているときには，とても不安になる。

items.en_self: I’d be tempted to use counterfeit money, if I were sure I could get away with it.
items.en_observer: He/she'd be tempted to use counterfeit money, if he/she were sure he/she could get away with it.
items.ja_self: もし絶対に捕まらないなら，偽札を使ってみたい。

items.en_self: I don't think of myself as the artistic or creative type.
items.en_observer: I don't think of him/her as the artistic or creative type.
items.ja_self: 自分のことを，芸術家タイプとか，創造的なタイプであるとは思わない。

items.en_self: People often call me a perfectionist.
items.en_observer: People often call him/her a perfectionist.
items.ja_self: 人からしばしば完全主義者だと言われる。

items.en_self: I find it hard to compromise with people when I really think I’m right.
items.en_observer: He/she finds it hard to compromise with people when he/she really thinks he/she is right.
items.ja_self: 私が本当に自分は正しいと思っているときには，人と妥協することは難しい。

items.en_self: The first thing that I always do in a new place is to make friends.
items.en_observer: The first thing that he/she always does in a new place is to make friends.
items.ja_self: 新しい場所に行っていつも最初にすることは，友達を作ることである。

items.en_self: I rarely discuss my problems with other people.
items.en_observer: He/she rarely discusses his/her problems with other people.
items.ja_self: 自分の問題を他の人と話し合ったりすることは，めったにない。

items.en_self: I would get a lot of pleasure from owning expensive luxury goods.
items.en_observer: He/she would get a lot of pleasure from owning expensive luxury goods.
items.ja_self: 高価で贅沢なものを所有することで，多くの楽しみが得られる。

items.en_self: I find it boring to discuss philosophy.
items.en_observer: He/she finds it boring to discuss philosophy.
items.ja_self: 哲学について議論するのは，うんざりである。

items.en_self: I prefer to do whatever comes to mind, rather than stick to a plan.
items.en_observer: He/she prefers to do whatever comes to mind, rather than stick to a plan.
items.ja_self: 私は，何でも計画通りにするよりも，思いついたことをするのが好きである。

items.en_self: I find it hard to keep my temper when people insult me.
items.en_observer: He/she finds it hard to keep his/her temper when people insult him/her.
items.ja_self: 人から侮辱されたときは，我慢することは難しい。

items.en_self: Most people are more upbeat and dynamic than I generally am.
items.en_observer: Most people are more upbeat and dynamic than he/she generally is.
items.ja_self: たいていの人は，私よりも陽気で活発である。

items.en_self: I remain unemotional even in situations where most people get very sentimental.
items.en_observer: He/she remains unemotional even in situations where most people get very sentimental.
items.ja_self: たいていの人がとても感傷的になるような状況でも，私は冷静でいられる。

items.en_self: I want people to know that I am an important person of high status.
items.en_observer: He/she wants people to know that he/she is an important person of high status.
items.ja_self: 私が高い地位にいる重要な人間であることを他の人に知ってほしい。

items.en_self: I have sympathy for people who are less fortunate than I am.
items.en_observer: He/she has sympathy for people who are less fortunate than he/she is.
items.ja_self: 自分よりも運が悪い人に対して，同情を感じる。

items.en_self: I try to give generously to those in need.
items.en_observer: He/she tries to give generously to those in need.
items.ja_self: 必要としている人には，気前よく提供しようとする．

items.en_self: It wouldn’t bother me to harm someone I didn’t like.
items.en_observer: It wouldn’t bother him/her to harm someone he/she didn’t like.
items.ja_self: 嫌いな人を傷つけても，自分が悩むことはない。

items.en_self: People see me as a hard-hearted person.
items.en_observer: People see him/her as a hard-hearted person.
items.ja_self: 人からは，私は冷たい人間だと思われている。
